title: Identity & Self-Mastery
voiceover_full: You aren't stuck. You're just loyal to a version of yourself that no longer exists. Self-mastery isn't about controlling your emotions. It’s about choosing who you become when they hit. Kill the old identity. Master the mind, and the world follows.
